# Vendored ai-skills scripts

Copied from ai-skills commit `535591b9094145df94baeb8fa92bf6faba2ebfc8`.
The local ai-skills checkout supplies one update to `implementer-core/scripts/collect_evidence.sh`
(Git blob `6eb168748aed016d33caa27447dd5a94442079d1`) to keep the first 40 status lines while consuming the full stream.
To refresh, copy the same eight scripts from an ai-skills checkout into the mirrored
directories, retain executable mode 0755, update the commit above, and run the tests.
